newsitem.title: CANADA: Scotiabank to issue C$350 mln debentures.
newsitem.headline: Scotiabank to issue C$350 mln debentures.

text.p: The Bank of Nova Scotia on Tuesday said it has issued C$350 million subordinated debentures to mature December 4, 2006.

The bank also said it will call for redemption the 14 million floating rate cumulative preferred shares, series one. The series one shares will be redeemed on December 5, 1996 at par plus accrued and unpaid dividends, the bank said.

The Bank of Nova Scotia said the new issue will pay a fixed rate of interest of 6.0 percent until December 4, 2001, after which they will pay a floating rate equal to the 90-day bankers acceptance rate plus 1%.

The bank said subject to regulatory approval, the debentures are redeemable at the Canada Yield Price plus five basis points, or on or after December 4, 2001, they will be redeemable at par plus accrued and unpaid interest.
Scotiabank said following the capital issue and redemption, the Bank's capital ratios will remain unchanged and well in excess of regulatory requirements.
